identity.rationale: Official OpenCompass obqa config names openbookqa and openbookqa_fact with their dataset paths; this directory is not another independent benchmark. Preserve main/fact protocol distinctions.

usefulness.rationale: Not established for current frontier/open comparisons in this pilot.

review.rationale: Official OpenCompass config maps the obqa directory to the OpenBookQA dataset: the main protocol uses abbr openbookqa with path opencompass/openbookqa_test and name main, while the separate fact protocol uses abbr openbookqa_fact with path opencompass/openbookqa_fact and name additional. The obqa directory is therefore a harness/configuration location, not an independent benchmark; preserve the main/fact protocol distinction.
